notes: Every card face is generated from its canonical definition; text and numbers are SVG text, not baked pixels.
Vessel illustrations are projections of the same voxel model the battlefield renders.
Open cards/<id>.svg directly, or Cards/index.html for the contact sheet.

cards.name: Antlered Bulwark
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: The antlers are for the first rank. The bulk is for everything behind it.

cards.name: Bell of the Unmoored
cards.rules: A floating temple bell grown through with roots, hung with small wooden charms and pale green motes.
cards.flavor: Its toll guides the lost, though none agree where they arrive.

cards.name: Bramble Stalker
cards.rules: Low thorn-backed predator with a whip-briar tail and leaf-blade jaws.
cards.flavor: The bramble moves first. The thorns arrive a moment later.

cards.name: Canopy Wyrm
cards.rules: Long green wyrm with leaf-membrane wings, a serpentine neck and root-claw feet.
cards.flavor: It nests above the canopy so that the whole forest hears it arrive.

cards.name: Grove Harrier
cards.rules: Lithe scout with a leaf cloak, paired short blades and a low forward stance.
cards.flavor: She moves through the grove without disturbing a single leaf, which is the only warning it gives.

cards.name: Hollowroot Oracle
cards.rules: A robed root-seer with a hollow timber mask, suspended seed-lights, and a staff grown from a single pale branch.
cards.flavor: Its roots remember every footstep.

cards.name: Mossback Warden
cards.rules: Wide rooted giant with a mossy shell back, stump fists and hanging vines.
cards.flavor: Counting its rings is a task measured in dynasties.

cards.name: The First Bloom
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: Every garden is a copy of this one, and every copy is a little less certain.

cards.name: Thornmarch Ranger
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: She marks the trail with thorns so the ones behind her can find their way back. Most of them do.

cards.name: Thornwood Sentinel
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: It was planted here before the border was drawn. It sees no reason to move.

cards.name: Verdant Colossus
cards.rules: A hulking walking grove of dark bark, mossy stone, thick root legs, and a crown of square-cut branches.
cards.flavor: A forest stands wherever it kneels.

cards.name: Whisperleaf Oracle
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: The leaves tell her what happens next. They are rarely polite about it.

cards.name: Willow-Veil Priest
cards.rules: Tall willowy figure behind a hanging veil, driftwood staff and root-wrapped feet.
cards.flavor: The veil is woven from the tree that will eventually be her grave, and it is not yet in a hurry.

cards.name: Ash-Veil Assassin
cards.rules: Compact hooded assassin, twin curved knives, scarf tails like smoke.
cards.flavor: The veil is not for hiding. It is so no one sees the last face they will.

cards.name: Ashen Crownblade
cards.rules: Frontline duelist with a broad ember-edged sword, scorched ivory armor, and a crown-shaped voxel helm.
cards.flavor: A fallen champion whose blade still burns.

cards.name: Cinder Warden
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: The shield is scorched through, and still it is the last thing the line sees.

cards.name: Cinder-Maw
cards.rules: A furnace-backed demon hound with split obsidian jaws, molten ribs, and short heavy limbs that leave ember marks.
cards.flavor: The furnace inside it never learned restraint.

cards.name: Cinderwatch Knight
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: She carries the watch-fire from post to post, and the axe is only there so nobody argues about the route.

cards.name: Emberwright Adept
cards.rules: Slender duelist in a split tabard, one ember-etched longsword and a high collar.
cards.flavor: She signs each rune with the flat of the blade, then lets the steel finish the sentence.

cards.name: Furnace Abbot
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: He reads the names of the fallen into the coals so the forge remembers them.

cards.name: Glass-Horn Charger
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: Its horns are cooled glass; the sound they make on armour is the last warning anyone gets.

cards.name: Kiln Tyrant
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: Its breath is the heat of the room it was built to defend.

cards.name: Obsidian Lancer
cards.rules: Tall lancer in plated greaves, long obsidian spear with a fringe of ember glass.
cards.flavor: The lance was quarried, not forged. It has never needed sharpening.

cards.name: Pyre Sovereign
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: It does not arrive. The room simply becomes the inside of a pyre.

cards.name: Slagborn Pyromancer
cards.rules: Hooded caster with a slag-iron staff and a loose furnace-orange sash.
cards.flavor: Born in the cooling trough, she has never once been cold.

cards.name: The Star-Eater
cards.rules: A vast angular void-being with a floating eclipse core, disconnected voxel rings, and a silhouette that bends inward.
cards.flavor: At the edge of night, even constellations fall silent.

cards.name: Bastion of the First Mountain
cards.rules: A towering square-shouldered stone sentinel with layered cliff armor, mineral seams, and a tiny glowing core.
cards.flavor: The valley grew around its patience.

cards.name: Clayfist Brawler
cards.rules: Broad bare-knuckle fighter with oversized clay gauntlets and a wrapped torso.
cards.flavor: The fists are still wet. They will be stone by the time they land.

cards.name: Crown of Dust
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: The empire is gone. The crown has not been told.

cards.name: Dust Sage
cards.rules: Stooped sage with a sand-glass staff, layered desert robes and a shard crown.
cards.flavor: He has been reading the same page for forty years, and it has not finished with him.

cards.name: Dustveil Matriarch
cards.rules: A broad desert beetle-lion with sandstone plates, layered mandibles, and a mantle of drifting mineral dust.
cards.flavor: Her tracks vanish before the dust settles.

cards.name: Gilt-Ash Bargainer
cards.rules: A horned contract-broker with cracked gold masks, heavy stone cuffs, and parchment strips sealed into its armor.
cards.flavor: Every oath has a price; every price leaves a mark.

cards.name: Oathstone Knight
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: The stone remembers the words. That is the whole of the oath: be the part of the wall that does not move.

cards.name: Obsidian Mason
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: It lays its own replacement stones when they fall. The wall is never quite finished.

cards.name: Quarry Engineer
cards.rules: Aproned engineer with a bucket-chain pack, stone-cutting pike and ear guards.
cards.flavor: She does not build walls. She finds the ones that are already there and improves them.

cards.name: Rootbound Witness
cards.rules: An ancient monolith wrapped in thick roots, with carved stone eyes and a crown of weathered standing stones.
cards.flavor: It has watched kingdoms rise from dust and return to it.

cards.name: Rubble Warden
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: The armour was assembled from a wall. It remembers being difficult to get through.

cards.name: Slatehorn Ram
cards.rules: Heavy mountain ram with layered slate horns, a stone-wool coat and iron-shod hooves.
cards.flavor: The horns are slate. The rest of it is considerably less brittle.

cards.name: Tomb Colossus
cards.rules: Huge burial colossus wrapped in carved bands, a sarcophagus back and a broken crown.
cards.flavor: The tomb was built to keep it in. Nobody asked what it wanted.

cards.name: Argent Nightlancer
cards.rules: A disciplined general in silver-black lamellar armor, carrying a long narrow lance and a banner clasp shaped like a crescent.
cards.flavor: One precise strike can end a long war.

cards.name: Clockwork Hydra
cards.rules: Brass hydra with three articulated necks, gear-jointed legs and a coiled mainspring back.
cards.flavor: Cut off a head and it winds another one. The spring is the only thing it truly loves.

cards.name: Cloudbreak Coil
cards.rules: A serpentine sky-dragon with segmented steel scales, turbine-like fins, and a forked crest shaped like lightning rods.
cards.flavor: Its iron whiskers split thunder before the storm arrives.

cards.name: Copper Squire
cards.rules: Youthful squire in too-large copper plate with a straight short sword.
cards.flavor: The sword is too long, the armour too bright, and the courage entirely dogged.

cards.name: Ironstep Sentinel
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: It has guarded the same doorway for a century, and the doorway has moved twice.

cards.name: Ironvow Paladin
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: Every rivet in the armour is a promise. She has never broken one, and the armour has never needed replacing.

cards.name: Ironwrought Hound
cards.rules: A compact articulated steel hound with exposed piston joints, a wedge-shaped muzzle, and a single amber sensor.
cards.flavor: Its nose detects weakness in steel and flesh.

cards.name: Lattice Artificer
cards.rules: Workshop artisan with a lattice frame pack, a brace of brass tools and a visored cap.
cards.flavor: She builds the small machines that make the larger ones possible.

cards.name: Null-Choir Cantor
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: The choir sings a note that removes the possibility of a next one.

cards.name: Razorline Duelist
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: The wire is not a weapon. The wire is the line you are not allowed to cross.

cards.name: Stormforge Lancer
cards.rules: Plated lancer with a coil-headed spear, storm fin crest and a short cape.
cards.flavor: The lance is a lightning rod. The rider is the storm that decided to keep it.

cards.name: The Quiet Engine
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: It has no sound, no exhaust and no explanation. It simply keeps the board exactly where it is.

cards.name: Tidemark Astrologer
cards.rules: A masked sky-reader carrying a rotating brass astrolabe, segmented robe panels, and a thin halo of silver markers.
cards.flavor: She charts the future in the gaps between falling stars.

cards.name: Abyssal Cartographer
cards.rules: Goggled cartographer with a floating chart-slate, weighted boots and a brass sextant.
cards.flavor: Every trench it charts is one more place the enemy cannot hide.

cards.name: Brine Hound
cards.rules: Swift — Enters play ready instead of waiting a turn.
cards.flavor: It runs with the tide and arrives before the sound of it.

cards.name: Lantern of the Lost Choir
cards.rules: A floating blue-glass lantern wrapped in ribbon-like water and tiny mask fragments that orbit its core.
cards.flavor: A small light that recalls forgotten names.

cards.name: Leviathan Shard
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: A splinter of something that was already old when the sea was young.

cards.name: Mireglass Stalker
cards.rules: Lean amphibious predator with translucent teal plates, long foreclaws, and a low silhouette built for fast flanking.
cards.flavor: It follows the ripples left by fear.

cards.name: Reef Duelist
cards.rules: Lean duelist with a coral sabre, bandaged off-hand and a finned shoulder guard.
cards.flavor: Coral cuts are shallow. She has never needed a second one.

cards.name: Riptide Monk
cards.rules: Bare-armed monk with wave-wrapped forearms, a wide stance and a trailing sash.
cards.flavor: The tide does not block. It simply makes the next step impossible.

cards.name: Saltglass Siren
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: Her last note hangs in the air long after the rest of her has gone.

cards.name: The Hollow Current
cards.rules: Deathrattle Draw — When defeated, its controller draws a card.
cards.flavor: It leaves nothing behind but a colder room and one fewer answer.

cards.name: The Unwritten Guest
cards.rules: An uncanny figure made from suspended rain-glass shards, with a blank faceplate and a cloak that flows upward.
cards.flavor: Every witness recalls a different shape standing in the rain.

cards.name: Tidecaller Acolyte
cards.rules: Small robed acolyte holding a shell-topped stave, hair wrapped in wet cloth.
cards.flavor: She can call a wave. On most days she is still practising the smaller version.

cards.name: Tidewall Sentinel
cards.rules: Stalwart — Enters play with 2 additional Guard.
cards.flavor: He holds the causeway alone at low tide, and the sea has learned to wait.

cards.name: Wyrm of the Drowned Vault
cards.rules: A long deep-sea dragon with pearl-blue scale blocks, a crown of broken ship bells, and fins like torn sails.
cards.flavor: Its hoard is measured in sunken centuries.

cards.name: Barkbound Ward
cards.rules: Grant +0 Attack and +4 Guard permanently.
cards.flavor: A ring of living wood closes around the bitten limb.

cards.name: Thorned Vigil
cards.rules: Grant +2 Attack and +2 Guard permanently.
cards.flavor: Roots tighten, bark hardens, and the watch resumes.

cards.name: Verdant Rebuke
cards.rules: Deal 5 damage, resolved elementally.
cards.flavor: The forest does not object. It simply grows through the objection.

cards.name: Wellspring Draught
cards.rules: Gain 3 Flux this turn.
cards.flavor: One mouthful and the whole day's work becomes possible.

cards.name: Ashen Communion
cards.rules: Deal 5 damage and restore half of it to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: The fire offers a trade: their heat for yours.

cards.name: Ashfall
cards.rules: Deal 2 damage to every enemy Vessel.
cards.flavor: The sky remembers the furnace it used to be.

cards.name: Cinder Sweep
cards.rules: Deal 4 damage to every enemy Vessel.
cards.flavor: The furnace doors open. The room is the furnace.

cards.name: Ember Lance
cards.rules: Deal 5 damage, resolved elementally.
cards.flavor: A spear of furnace-light, thrown along a line that was already burning.

cards.name: Hearthlight
cards.rules: Restore 4 Vitality to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: Some fires are kept for warmth, not for war.

cards.name: Last Light
cards.rules: Deal 7 damage to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Not a sunrise. The other thing that happens at the end of a long day.

cards.name: Quickening Spark
cards.rules: Ready a Vessel you control so it can move and attack again.
cards.flavor: One spark is enough to remind a weapon what it is for.

cards.name: Searing Brand
cards.rules: Grant +3 Attack and +0 Guard permanently.
cards.flavor: A mark that says: this one is worth hitting harder.

cards.name: Granite Grasp
cards.rules: Stun an enemy Vessel: it misses its next activation.
cards.flavor: Stone closes around the ankle and waits for the rest of the argument.

cards.name: Quarry Verdict
cards.rules: Deal 7 damage, resolved elementally.
cards.flavor: Stone does not argue. It concludes.

cards.name: Reliquary Echo
cards.rules: Return your most expensive defeated Vessel from the discard to your hand.
cards.flavor: The tomb remembers the shape of a hero and returns it, slightly dustier.

cards.name: Siege Canticle
cards.rules: Deal 4 damage to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Sung in a register that walls find persuasive.

cards.name: Stonehide Rite
cards.rules: Grant +0 Attack and +5 Guard permanently.
cards.flavor: The skin remembers being mountainside.

cards.name: Flux Surge
cards.rules: Gain 2 Flux this turn.
cards.flavor: A brief, indecent amount of power arrives from somewhere it should not.

cards.name: Lodestone Survey
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Every needle points at an answer someone buried.

cards.name: Null Manacle
cards.rules: Stun an enemy Vessel: it misses its next activation.
cards.flavor: It is not a lock. It is the absence of anywhere to go.

cards.name: Quillstorm
cards.rules: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Every map has a margin. This is what lives in it.

cards.name: Sunder the Gate
cards.rules: Deal 5 damage to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: The gate was built to hold. It was not built to hold this.

cards.name: Voltaic Veil
cards.rules: Deal 3 damage to every enemy Vessel.
cards.flavor: The air becomes a decision that everyone on the field regrets.

cards.name: Wake the Line
cards.rules: Ready a Vessel you control so it can move and attack again.
cards.flavor: The bell is rung once. The line answers as if it had never stopped.

cards.name: Glass Meridian
cards.rules: Deal 4 damage, resolved elementally.
cards.flavor: A thin line of water, held perfectly still until it is not.

cards.name: Gravesong
cards.rules: Return your most expensive defeated Vessel from the discard to your hand.
cards.flavor: The tide brings back the name, and the name brings back the rest.

cards.name: Saltwake Cut
cards.rules: Deal 6 damage, resolved elementally.
cards.flavor: The reef teaches one lesson, repeatedly and with a blade.

cards.name: Siphon Tithe
cards.rules: Deal 4 damage and restore half of it to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: The sea takes a portion of everything it touches.

cards.name: Tidewall
cards.rules: Restore 5 Vitality to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: A wall of water is still a wall, and it is still yours.

cards.name: Undertow Mend
cards.rules: Restore 4 Guard to a Vessel you control.
cards.flavor: The tide returns what the shore has taken.

cards.name: Dawnroot Idol
cards.rules: Relic · at the start of your turn, heal 3 Guard.
cards.flavor: At first light the roots carry a little of the forest into whoever is still standing.

cards.name: Verdant Seal
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels have +2 Guard.
cards.flavor: New growth arrives already armored.

cards.name: Ashwake Crown
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels take 1 less Action damage.
cards.flavor: Every Vessel under it has already survived one burning.

cards.name: Ember Lens
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels' attacks deal +1.
cards.flavor: It focuses a candle's worth of heat into every blade you raise.

cards.name: Mountain Oath
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels take 2 less Action damage.
cards.flavor: Sworn to a stone that has never once broken its word.

cards.name: Quicklime Sigil
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels have +1 Guard.
cards.flavor: A thin crust of chalk that makes every blow cost more.

cards.name: Stone Sigil
cards.rules: Relic · your Nexus takes 1 less damage.
cards.flavor: Your Nexus wears the mountain's refusal.

cards.name: Brass Standard
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels' attacks deal +2.
cards.flavor: Raised once, and the whole line remembers how to advance.

cards.name: Swift Banner
cards.rules: Relic · your Vessels enter play ready.
cards.flavor: The banner is always already moving when the order arrives.

cards.name: Choir Bell
cards.rules: Relic · at the start of your turn, heal 2 Guard.
cards.flavor: At every dawn it rings once, and something wounded remembers how to hold.

cards.name: Oracular Prism
cards.rules: Relic · draw 1 extra card at the start of your turn.
cards.flavor: It shows the next card. It is not interested in whether you wanted to see it.

cards.name: Tideglass Aegis
cards.rules: Relic · your Nexus takes 2 less damage.
cards.flavor: The Nexus wears a shield made of the sea's most patient hour.
